How SOP updates work

Keep client names on their own line. For a new client, use “Client: Client Name” on its own line, then write points below it. Refresh reads the current document text. Screenshot content and linked documents are not extracted. Earlier PDF reminders stay available as an explicitly dated snapshot. For Google Doc refresh, use the included launcher. For private documents, paste updated text or import a text-based PDF or TXT file below.

Import updated SOP / paste document text

Export your updated Google Doc as plain text (.txt), or upload a text-based PDF. Use existing client names as headings, or “Client: Name”. Import replaces the displayed client list; old checks are cleared. Image-only PDFs need text pasted manually.

      Final Excel

      Upload raw Excel, select your client format, then download your finished workbook.

      Creates Summary, EARTHWORK and EROSION CONTROL, including limerock/subgrade. Raw cut/fill quantities are retained. Import costs are positive. Tons are rounded to 2 decimals before pricing; truck equivalents are displayed without rounding up.

      Review rates and conversion settings

      Other erosion items start at $0. Edit their rates in the downloaded workbook; Summary updates automatically.

      Reads surface quantities, topsoil respread, onsite/offsite areas, trench quantities and erosion phases. Other trades are not included.

      Choose a raw workbook to begin.

      All County includes onsite, offsite and Phase 2 earthwork, erosion control and related base/subgrade Summary items. Other trades are outside this client output. No extra cut/fill factors are applied.
